purpose: The FIFTH pinned policy: authorizes the official-class budget (39321 new tokens) with the official no-repeat suppression (35/1024, generated ids only) for the 221 CAMPAIGN_POLICY_REQUIRED documents (6..15 pages) of the frozen full-scope MPDocBench manifest, executed sequentially through the ledger-integrated campaign runner after TWO conditions are met: this digest is pinned by a reviewed commit, AND an explicit owner authorization names this digest in the run config. Neither condition alone executes anything. Production-class documents (171, <=5 pages) never consume this policy: they run on the production path at budget 8192 exactly as validated and piloted.
claim_limit: REAL_MEASUREMENT_ONLY until the full-scope run completes and passes the comparability audit. A campaign run is NOT a leaderboard claim, NOT official-deployment parity (no SGLang windowing, no KV reuse), and produces no delta versus the Baidu reference until public_report comparability gates pass. Truncated/failed/timed-out documents are published as FULL_WITH_FAILURES with failures visible — never retried into PASS, never silently dropped from the 420 denominator.

documents.rule: every document the frozen full-scope classifier places in CAMPAIGN_POLICY_REQUIRED (6..15 pages, benchmark.campaign.classify_document) at execution time, from the frozen manifest
documents.page_hash_gate: eval/benchmarks/g05/datasets/MPDocBench-page-index.json (worker verifies actual bytes per page before inference)

admission.rule: pages*prompt_upper_bound + budget + margin must not exceed context_cap_tokens; classify/admit arithmetic ONLY — budget sufficiency is a runtime outcome (TRUNCATED accounting), never a pre-flight guarantee

ngram_scope: generated tokens only (official SGLang SGLANG_UOCR_NGRAM_OUTPUT_ONLY=True semantics; frozen model loop scans gen only)
ngram_provenance: official client infer.py@48ff432 (docs/rca/NGRAM35_SOURCE_AUDIT.md); same suppression identity validated by L1 (dd23a546) and L1.1-B (d95e5bd0) at this exact budget class; the guard-collision corner is LIVE at this budget class per docs/validation/P2C_GUARD_COLLISION_SAFETY.md §6

guard_collision_safety.contract: observer aborts before selection on the audited corner; any abort classifies the attempt FAIL and BLOCKS campaign promotion; the post-run replay forced-marker detector remains a HARD gate with no bypass
guard_collision_safety.observer: pre-selection all--inf abort (src/unlimited_ocr_2_rocm/collision_observer.py), REQUIRED for every campaign-class attempt

ledger.not_run_marking: the 28 NATIVE_UNSUPPORTED_OVER_15P documents stay NOT_RUN/BLOCKED in every ledger and public accounting; NOT_RUN is never PASS; the 420-document denominator is never subset
ledger.failure_visibility: TRUNCATED/FAIL/TIMEOUT rows are preserved and published as-is; the ledger is append-only; no terminal state is ever retried into PASS

resource_admission.gpu_enforcement: worker ResourceWatchdog samples torch.cuda.memory_allocated and aborts the attempt (exit 86 + breach receipt) when the hard limit is crossed — enforced during execution, not merely checked afterward
resource_admission.measured_envelope: pilot 24-doc measured envelope 38-128 GPU-hours (median per-page 38.3 s, P95 117.4 s, L1.1-B 194 s/page upper anchor); watchdog peaks 8.55 GiB allocated / 8.78 GiB reserved / 2.48 GiB RSS; per-attempt model load ~4 s is inside the anchors
resource_admission.timeout_rationale: L1.1-B measured this budget class at 2913 s wall for the densest 15-page document; 7200 s is a 2.47x margin (>=1.8x at the L1 decode floor of 10.4 tok/s). May only be changed via a reviewed policy update BEFORE the run, never mid-run.

batching.mode: sequential documents, one supervised worker per document
batching.resume: ledger resume after any interruption re-serves only non-terminal documents; every attempt keeps its numbered receipt with hash seals
batching.protocol_freeze: no mid-campaign parameter changes — a protocol change means a new Run ID and a new receipt lineage, never an amendment of the running one

abort_criteria: watchdog breach (16 GiB allocated) halts the campaign for review
OOM classification halts the campaign for review
ledger hash-seal mismatch halts the campaign for review
TIMEOUT does NOT halt: the document is kept as TIMEOUT and the campaign continues; a systemic timeout pattern is a review trigger, not a silent continue

unchanged.native_page_guard: enabled (expected_pages = the document's page count from the frozen manifest; max_page_tokens=20000)

environment_pin.wheel_source: wheels/ local builds (gfx1151); unchanged from L1/L1.1-B and the pilot

scoring.strict: official eight-metric scorer over every completed document, frozen gt-slice export; metrics without samples stay null and Overall is null by rule for any document set where the rule applies
scoring.diagnostic: diagnostic scorer receipt per document as in the pilot; full-denominator accounting preserved (420 documents in every public report)
scoring.publication: public-results.json only through benchmark/public_report.py comparability gates; the audit refuses denominator mismatches and unverified comparisons
